name: query_messages
description: Search the user's iMessage database. Set action=count for how many, first for earliest/when first, read for catch-up/investigation of a person, otherwise search.

query.description: Only words expected inside message bodies; never put a person's name or date here

with.description: Contact whose conversation is searched or read

from.description: me if the user sent it; otherwise the contact who sent it

in.description: Date phrase copied from the request, such as last week, this month, yesterday, all time, or a date range

name: rank_activity
description: Rank the user's iMessage contacts or group chats by message volume. Use for top/most/biggest contact or group questions.

chat.description: Optional named group whose members should be ranked

in.description: Date phrase copied from the request; all time when absent

name: overview_stats
description: Get total, sent, received, and distinct-chat counts for overall iMessage activity in a date window.

in.description: Date phrase copied from the request

name: find_people
description: Search contact names or find people whose messaging relationship with the user began since a date.

name.description: Name to find when searching contacts

since.description: Start date or date phrase for new friends

name: find_plans
description: Find plans, meetings, commitments, and things the user agreed to do in sent iMessages during a date window.

in.description: Date phrase copied from the request
